text: I think you'll really enjoy this Arctic Char With Pears recipe, given your taste for soy sauce and cured meat. Although it doesn't contain soy sauce, the combination of flavors from the Grand Marnier, ginger, and curry powder will likely appeal to you. Additionally, this dish is relatively quick to prepare and cooks in about 22 minutes, fitting within your 45-minute time frame. As for your health goal of lowering sodium intake, this recipe is a good choice as it has a moderate amount of sodium, which is lower than many other seafood recipes.
